jobs.title: People Operations Generalist
jobs.summary: About Homebot Homebot is a homeownership platform used by mortgage lenders, real estate agents, and title and companies to help their clients build wealth through homeownership.
jobs.description:
About Homebot
Homebot is a homeownership platform used by mortgage lenders, real estate agents, and title and companies to help their clients build wealth through homeownership. As a small but mighty team (~80 people), we value self-starters who are scrappy, eager, and ready to take on big challenges.

The Role
We are seeking a People Operations Generalist with a foundational understanding of HR, talent acquisition, and employee payroll and benefits who is motivated to grow their expertise across the employee experience. From day one, you’ll own real breadth, including facilities management, recruiting coordination, onboarding, HR systems, team meetings and events, employee support, benefits administration, and a slice of payroll. This is not a role for someone seeking routine. We’re looking for a multitasker who thrives in a dynamic environment, juggling in-the-moment requests while driving projects forward. If you spot a broken process, you dive in to improve it before being asked. You're quick to learn new technology and are eager to leverage AI for smarter, more efficient work.
This is a full-time, hybrid position based out of our Denver office. The team works in office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and you're comfortable working in the office as needed to keep facilities management humming. You must be located in the Denver area.

Your Team
You’ll report directly to the Director of People Operations, collaborate closely with the Finance team, work alongside managers, and directly support ~80 Homebotters.

What You'll Do
- Recruiting coordination: Manage scheduling, configure our ATS (Ashby), and coordinate with hiring teams to keep hiring campaigns on track. Serve as the face of our talent function, conducting phone screens and managing all candidate correspondence. Grow into sourcing and hiring optimization as you build your track record.

- Onboarding: Co-own, iterate, and execute new-hire processes from offer acceptance to the first week. Set up payroll and systems, manage stakeholders, and partner with colleagues to create a stellar welcome for new Homebotters.

- HR systems & data integrity: Maintain employee data and optimize our tech stack (Paylocity, Ashby, benefits portals, Slack, Notion, Google Drive, etc.). Proactively identify opportunities for AI and automation to reduce manual work. You’ll balance requirements from legacy systems with state and federal compliance, while innovating workflows to improve visibility, compliance, and efficiency for the People Operations function.

- Employee support & administration: Act as a trusted point of contact for all Homebotters. Field questions on everything from company policies, to team meetings, to People Ops processes. Bring a warm, solutions-oriented approach to every interaction.

- Benefits knowledge: Become an expert in our perks and benefits programs, supporting employees in maximizing their value. Manage self-service resources, answer ad-hoc questions, and keep a strong working knowledge of state/federal leave and benefits interactions.

- Payroll support: Maintain accurate employee data, manage payroll changes, and ensure clear communication with Finance. Support timely and accurate payroll. Gain exposure to audits, multi-state compliance, and accounting processes.

- Office & facilities: Manage in-office resources and building logistics for our Denver office. Help with everything from building fob access to deliveries to parking questions.

- Event planning: Plan and execute team gatherings and events, from team lunches, to onsites, to seasonal celebrations. Delight in opportunities to bring the team together while managing the organizational systems that facilitate these connection events.

What Success Looks Like
At 90 days
You’ve immersed yourself in Homebot’s culture, learned core People Operations workflows and are running most of them independently. Success will be demonstrated through thoughtful questions, improving messy or incomplete processes, quickly adopting tools and systems, staying organized in your onboarding, and forging strong relationships across the team. Homebotters will immediately feel comfortable approaching you for help and guidance, and you'll feel confident supporting them.
By six months
You are a trusted partner to employees and managers for daily People Ops needs. You’re running payroll with Finance's guidance, completing employee file updates, running leave administration, planning team events, spearheading hiring campaigns and keeping them on track, and implementing technology-forward efficiency improvements.

What You'll Need
- 3+ years in a People Ops, HR, or Talent role, OR a generalist or admin role that regularly supported payroll, benefits, onboarding, or hiring

- Experience working at a small organization (under 200 employees)

- Exposure to state and federal compliance and employment law

- High level of ownership and autonomy, alongside comfort working in an ambiguous and dynamic environment

- Comfort and eagerness to use a variety of tools and systems (HRIS, ATS, Slack, Notion)

- A genuine interest in using AI to build more efficient workflows and solutions

- Strong initiative and self-direction in your work and learning

- Curious about specific People Ops areas you’d like to grow into

- Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills

- Experience delivering quality customer service with warmth and professionalism

- Organized, detail-oriented and high level of accuracy. Spreadsheets are your friend

- Comfortable juggling many priorities at once with grace and a “can-do” attitude

Desired but not required:
- Prior exposure to payroll processing

- Background at an early-stage or scaling company

Compensation & Benefits
Homebot is committed to offering competitive pay and benefits reflective of the Denver market. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including skills, qualifications, and professional experience. In addition to base salary and a company-performance bonus, all full-time employees are eligible to receive Equity Appreciation Rights (stock units) as part of their total compensation package, providing an opportunity to share in Homebot's long-term growth and success.
 
Compensation
This role has an annual target base salary of $75,000 - $85,000, plus an annual 10% bonus based on company goal attainment, plus company equity. Compensation is determined based on experience and our interview process.
 
Perks/Benefits
- Robust medical, dental, and vision insurance

- 401(k) match

- Flexible Vacation Policy

- 12 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave for all parents

- Access to Wellhub with employer discount

- Home office budget upon hire

- Denver EcoPass or paid parking

- Lunch delivery service in-office on Thursdays

- Annual learning & development budget

- Pet insurance offering

- Hybrid working model - Tuesdays and Thursdays are in-office at our RiNo space

- Onsite gym

 
Homebot Values and Culture
Homebot is enriched by a variety of personalities and perspectives on our team. We believe that everyone comes from a diverse set of backgrounds and every team member brings different skills to the collective.
Homebot is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and we encourage all applicants to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment, transfer, or promotion opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation including transgender status, national origin/ancestry, genetics, pregnancy, disability, age, marital status, familial status or veteran status. Research shows that underrepresented groups may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box!
 
Who We Strive To Be as Homebotters
- We are Humbly Hungry

- We are Courageously Authentic

- We Challenge Limiting Beliefs

- We Keep our Eye on the Ball, Hand in the Dirt

- We win, lose and grow as a team, together!

jobs.summary: Who We Are Invitation Homes is a team of more than 1,700 associates who come from all walks of life. We call different communities “home," but our shared values bind us together.
jobs.description:
Who We Are
Invitation Homes is a team of more than 1,700 associates who come from all walks of life. We call different communities “home," but our shared values bind us together. Invitation Homes is a place where possibility lives.

The market teams include our Leasing, Property Management and Rehab, Turns & Maintenance professionals. Together, our dedicated associates work hard to build excellent resident experiences while maintaining high-quality homes and ensuring potential residents are presented with a rental property they can’t refuse.

Your Role on the Team
As a Superintendent at Invitation Homes you are responsible for full-cycle oversight of property rehab and turnover efforts. This includes but is not limited to the following tasks:
- Meeting with residents to complete Pre Move-Out Visits and documenting the home condition and resident responsibilities for a successful move-out.

- Meeting with incoming residents to complete Resident Orientations to welcome them, and educate them on the systems in their home as well as all important maintenance policies and procedures

- Conducting Move Out Inspections including a detailed inspection of the property and using our budgeting program to create a comprehensive scope of work and identify costs that should be charged back to the resident at move-out in accordance with company standards

- Overseeing all aspects of the rehab and turn process which includes communicating with contractors, submitting change orders, ensuring work is completed correctly and on schedule, and documenting the process with progress notes and “before” and “after” photos

- Communicating with the Leasing Team about completion delays that might affect a resident’s move-in date

- Observing and ensuring job site safety during project management visits

- Negotiating terms of repairs with vendors and General Contractors based on company standards

- May be required to conduct occupancy checks and attend eviction lockouts/setouts in coordination with local law enforcement

- Performing other duties as assigned

Your Experience Includes
- High school diploma or equivalent

- OSHA 10 is required (new hires will have up to 90 days to complete OSHA 10 certification if not already certified)

- Minimum two years of project management experience managing multiple projects, budgets, timelines, and quality of work

- General knowledge of residential construction including plumbing, electrical, mechanical, HVAC, drywall, and flooring as well as local building codes

- Negotiating with and managing contractors to complete work

- Professional verbal and written communication skills

- Comfortability with using a tablet and general business applications (e.g. Outlook, Salesforce, etc.)

- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills

- Current driver’s license and automobile insurance

- Must provide basic hand and power tools 

- Ability to be at work on a regular and consistent basis including on weekends and non-traditional holidays if needed

- Extensive travel within assigned portfolio required

- Physical requirements include:
- Frequent climbing, reaching, use of fingers, stooping, kneeling, crawling, pushing, pulling, lifting, talking, and hearing

- Ability to lift and/or move an excess of 50 pounds or more and operate standard maintenance equipment as assigned

Why Us
We stand for flexibility, opportunity, and a home that people can make their own. It’s as true for our associates as it is for our residents. Just like we help our residents live freer, we liberate our associates’ careers, too. Our associates know that goals matter, potential is unlocked, and careers thrive. Invitation Homes isn’t just a workplace but a possibility place. We offer each new associate:
- Competitive pay and an annual bonus program for all associates

- Generous paid time off plans including vacation accrual, sick time, volunteer time, and standard and floating holidays

- 401k with matching company contributions

- Awesome work environment with casual dress

- Team events and gatherings

- Employee resource groups: Together with Women, Asian Alliance, Black Collective, Juntos, Gen Next, Valor, and Open Invitation.

Build a foundation here and apply today!

Salary Range
The salary range for this position is: $57,862.50 - $100,295.00, plus individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications, location, and applicable employment laws.

Compensation and Benefits
To attract and retain top talent, we're pleased to offer competitive compensation and benefits, including:
- Annual bonus program

- Health, dental, vision, and life insurance

- Long-term and short-term disability insurance

- Generous paid time off plans include vacation accrual, sick time, standard holidays and floating holidays

- 401(k) with company matching contributions

- Awesome work environment with casual dress

- Team events and gatherings (Pre- and Post-Covid)

Invitation Homes is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and innovative environment with the best associates. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at humanresources@invitationhomes.com.

jobs.title: Internal Wholesaler
jobs.summary: About the Company There are 17 million Americans who own rental property. Most don't want to be landlords anymore, but selling isn't a good option.
jobs.description:
About the Company

There are 17 million Americans who own rental property. Most don't want to be landlords anymore, but selling isn't a good option. Why? You'd lose income and appreciation, trigger tax liabilities, kick out your tenants, have to fix up the house – the list goes on! Flock is here to help.

Flock's mission is to provide every retiring landlord with the most cost-efficient and seamless exit. Our first product is a tech-enabled 721 Exchange for residential landlords. Owners contribute properties into our professionally managed Fund, in exchange for passive equity ownership. It's a direct 721 Exchange model designed for everyday owners who want access to continued cashflows, liquidity, and diversification without triggering capital gains, disturbing tenants, or dealing with disposition friction. We're growing fast and are looking for smart, entrepreneurial hustlers who want to help build something category-defining.

We're backed by top tier investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Primary Ventures, Renegade Partners, SUSA Ventures, 1Sharpe Ventures, and leaders from Invitation Homes and Opendoor.

About the Role

We're hiring an Internal Wholesaler to build Flock's advisor channel. If you've spent 1–4 years as an internal wholesaler or internal sales consultant at an alternative investment sponsor, you know exactly what this is. But our product is different: a direct 721 exchange into a diversified residential portfolio is a story most RIAs haven't heard. You won't be the fourth DST wholesaler to call this week.

Your job is to own top-of-funnel outreach to Registered Investment Advisors whose clients own appreciated rental real estate.This is a high-activity, high-discipline role, where you’ll execute dozens of outbound touches per day, qualify genuine interest, and convert it into scheduled meetings with our Partnerships team. Success is measured by meetings booked and held each week, and over time, advisor relationships that mature into platform onboarding and client referrals.

What You'll Do

- Execute systematic outreach: Run 40–60 touches per day (calls, emails, LinkedIn) against a targeted list of RIAs, maintaining a track record of activity discipline and rigor.

- Deliver a credible first conversation: Explain what Flock's product is, which clients it fits, and why advisors are adding it to their toolkit—without a script and with the authenticity that comes from understanding tax-deferred real estate strategies.

- Qualify and book: Identify which advisors are genuine prospects, disqualify fast, and lock in qualified meetings with our Partnerships team.

- Own meeting logistics: Confirmations, reminders, reschedules, pre-meeting briefing notes—every meeting occurs because you made it happen.

- Maintain pipeline integrity: Keep your Salesforce hygiene tight so the team has a real-time picture of what's working and what isn't.

- Feed field intelligence back to the team: Surface objections you're hearing, competitive products advisors mention, gaps in your collateral. The feedback loop from you to product/marketing is tight—changes happen in days, not quarters.

About You

- 1–4 years of high-activity financial services sales, with direct experience calling financial advisors. You've succeeded as an internal wholesaler, internal sales consultant, regional internal consultant, or equivalent. You know your daily touch volume and exactly where you’re tracking to quota.

- Grit and activity discipline: You're comfortable with—and energized by—high-volume outbound and the adversity that comes with it. You don't view rejection as a barrier; you view it as feedback.

- Advisor EQ: You're credible on the phone with sophisticated counterparties. You listen more than you pitch. You understand that RIAs buy consultatively and do real due diligence.

- Organized and process-driven: You run your book like a system, not a scramble. Salesforce hygiene, follow-up discipline, and pipeline discipline are table stakes for you.

- CRM Fluency. You’ve leveraged a CRM like Salesforce, Hubspot, or similar as more than a contact book.

- Bonus points: Experience at an alternative investment sponsor (DST, non-traded REIT, interval fund, QOZ, private placement, or alts platform). Specific RIA-channel experience. Ability to explain tax-advantaged real estate structures conversationally.

Even if you don't meet 100% of the qualifications, we recommend applying to the role!

Location: New York, NY

Compensation: $110-140k OTE, plus equity and benefits (medical/dental/vision insurance, 401k, and unlimited PTO).

jobs.title: Founding National Wholesale Account Executive -- HELOC
jobs.summary: Why Better. Why Now. Better is rebuilding home finance as an AI-native platform—turning a process that once took weeks into something that can happen in seconds.
jobs.description:
Why Better. Why Now.
Better is rebuilding home finance as an AI-native platform—turning a process that once took weeks into something that can happen in seconds.

With over $110B in loans funded and $1.2B+ raised, we operate at real scale while rethinking how homeownership works from the ground up.

The category hasn’t caught up yet. That’s the opportunity.

Better Mortgage is rebuilding home finance around technology, speed, transparency, and a dramatically better customer experience. Better Wholesale is bringing that same ambition to the mortgage broker community, and we are looking for an exceptional Account Executive to help us build the channel from the ground up.

We are launching with a differentiated HELOC designed to give mortgage brokers a powerful new solution for their clients. The product combines a broad credit box, compelling broker economics, and a modern experience intended to make it an attractive alternative to many of the HELOC and home-equity products available today.

The market is already responding. Before launch, brokerages representing more than $10 billion in annual mortgage production committed to being among the first to access the product and offer it to their clients.

That makes this a very different kind of wholesale opportunity.

You will not begin with an empty territory and a list of cold prospects. You will step into meaningful existing demand and help turn that demand into activated broker partners, outstanding experiences, funded loans, and long-term relationships. You will also have a voice in shaping how Better Wholesale onboards, trains, supports, and grows with the broker community.

You will do it with the stability of guaranteed income, the security of a full-time W-2 position with a comprehensive benefits package, the flexibility to work remotely, and the uncapped upside of a production-based compensation plan.

This is an opportunity to do more than inherit a book of business. It is an opportunity to help build one.

The Opportunity

As a founding Wholesale Account Executive, you will be one of the primary faces of Better Wholesale to our earliest broker partners. You will develop relationships from onboarding through funding, helping brokers understand the product, confidently identify opportunities within their client base, navigate scenarios, submit high-quality files, and deliver a great experience to their clients.
Initially, the role will be weighted more toward broker activation, education, account growth, and execution than traditional cold prospecting. Over time, as Better Wholesale expands into non-QM and other lending products, the position is expected to evolve into broader business development and channel-building responsibilities.
For the right person, this role offers a meaningful opportunity to earn consideration for future wholesale leadership, as the channel expands and performance warrants.

What you will do

· Onboard and activate an initial group of high-potential mortgage brokerages that are already interested in the Better Wholesale HELOC.
· Build trusted, durable relationships with brokerage owners, leaders, loan originators, processors, and other key stakeholders.
· Train broker partners on Better Wholesale technology, product guidelines, pricing, eligibility, submission requirements, and best practices.
· Help brokers identify HELOC opportunities within their existing client databases and translate product interest into consistent submissions and funded volume.
· Serve as the primary relationship owner and advocate for assigned broker accounts throughout the loan lifecycle.
· Provide responsive scenario guidance and coordinate with operations, underwriting, product, and leadership to solve issues and manage escalations.
· Set clear expectations, communicate proactively, and create a high-touch broker experience that earns trust and repeat business.
· Own account-level production goals, pipeline visibility, pull-through, activation, and funded-volume forecasting.
· Track broker activity and relationship health through the company CRM and operating systems.
· Gather structured broker feedback and bring it back to product, technology, operations, pricing, and leadership so we can continuously improve the experience.
· Help create the onboarding materials, training programs, service standards, playbooks, and account-management processes that will support the future growth of Better Wholesale.
· Represent Better Wholesale in broker meetings, webinars, trainings, industry events, and other market-facing opportunities.
· As the channel evolves, identify and develop new broker relationships and help introduce additional wholesale products, including potential non-QM and traditional mortgage offerings.

What success looks like

In your first year, success will mean:
· Converting strong pre-launch interest into activated, engaged, producing broker partners.
· Building a meaningful and growing funded pipeline from assigned accounts.
· Becoming a trusted, highly responsive resource who brokers want to call first.
· Delivering a smooth onboarding and training experience that enables brokers to use the product confidently.
· Maintaining strong submission quality, pull-through, communication, and partner satisfaction.
· Turning broker feedback into actionable improvements across product, technology, guidelines, pricing, and operations.
· Helping establish a repeatable playbook that allows Better Wholesale to scale.
· Demonstrating the leadership, ownership, judgment, and performance required to take on broader responsibility as the channel grows.

What you bring

· Prior mortgage industry experience is required
· A demonstrated ability to build, manage, and grow relationships
· Working knowledge of wholesale lending, mortgage operations, pricing, underwriting guidelines, and the loan lifecycle.
· The ability to understand complex scenarios, explain guidelines clearly, and help partners determine the right next step without overpromising.
· Strong presentation and training skills, with the confidence to lead one-on-one conversations, group meetings, webinars, and product demonstrations.
· Exceptional follow-through, organization, urgency, and attention to detail.
· The ability to manage a large number of relationships and active loans while making each partner feel prioritized.
· A consultative, service-oriented sales style grounded in curiosity, credibility, and problem-solving.
· Comfort working in a fast-moving launch environment where processes will evolve and your input will help shape them.
· Proficiency with CRM, loan-origination, pricing, and modern communication tools.
· A growth mindset, high personal accountability, humility, resilience, and a genuine desire to build something meaningful with a team.

Who will thrive here

This opportunity is built for someone who is both a producer and a builder.
You know how to create momentum, but you do not confuse sales with pressure. You earn trust by being knowledgeable, responsive, direct, and genuinely useful. You care about the broker's business, the client's experience, and the quality of every loan that carries your name.
You are energized by the idea of joining early, helping create the playbook, and earning greater responsibility through performance. You do not need every process to be fully formed before you act; you help make the process better.
Most importantly, you want your next role to be more than another territory. You want the opportunity to help shape a new wholesale platform and grow with it.

Company Benefits
Our total rewards package is built around a competitive base salary, with benefits designed to support you and your family:

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA and FSA options with employer matching contributions

- Pre-tax Dependent Care FSA, plus commuter benefits with employer matching contributions

- 401(k) retirement savings plan

- Flexible PTO program and company-paid holidays

- Paid parental leave

- Remote and hybrid work arrangement options [role dependent]

- Discounted pet insurance and additional perks

- PerkSpot employee discount program

- SoFi financial wellbeing platform with 1:1 advice

- Employee assistance program supporting mental and emotional wellbeing

By the numbers:

We've funded over $110 billion in loans (more than any other fintech in the US!)
Raised over $1.2 billion in equity capital to modernize the $15 trillion mortgage industry
Better's proprietary AI platform, Tinman®, and voice-based AI mortgage assistant, Betsy™, make us an award-winning lender:
- Banking Tech Award USA (2026): Best LendTech Solution

- Fintech Breakthrough Award (2026): Digital Mortgage Company of the Year

- NerdWallet Best of Award (2026): Best for Home Equity Loans

- Fintech Breakthrough Award 2025: Best Lending Innovation

- Yahoo! Finance (2025): Best Mortgage Lender for First-Time Homebuyers – Best for quick approval

- Yahoo! Finance (2025): Best Online Mortgage Lender

- Money Magazine (2025): Best for fast closing

- Forbes (2023): Best Online Mortgage Lender

We're building the future of home finance — and we're looking for smart, driven, ambitious innovators who are ready to tackle the most impactful work of their careers.

Disclaimer
Better Home & Finance Holding Company is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse environment for our employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status, or any other reason protected by law.

We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical or mental disabilities. Better will not discriminate against any qualified individual who is capable of performing the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

Company Background:

Ownwell has developed a leading end-to-end property tax solution that is purpose-built for SFR and CRE investors, operators, and property managers. We have brought Data Science and Machine Learning to a space that is ripe for disruption. We combine a best-in-class technology stack with local market expertise to reduce expenses, increase Net Operating Income, and drive operational efficiency for both our institutional clients and individual homeowners. Ownwell’s solution ensures you have the necessary tools, resources, and information to confidently manage your property taxes.

Ownwell has been recognized both in Austin and Nationally, as a top workplace by the likes of Fortune, BuiltIn, Inc, and Best Places To Work. We are well-funded and venture-backed by some of the best investors in the world such as First Round Capital and Bessemer Venture Partners. Our customer base has grown by more than 300% year-over-year with exceptional feedback demonstrating clear product market fit. We are looking for driven and passionate team members who thrive in a collaborative, positive culture where we all win together. If this sounds like the place for you, come help us change the way everyday homeowners manage their real estate across the country.

Our Culture

People are our superpower! Centered in everything we do is a true sense of team. We listen and we learn from each other. We are on this rocketship together and embrace a fast-paced, truly collaborative environment. We are here to win as a team and as a company.

We’ve brought together General Appraisers, Certified Public Accountants, Property Tax Consultants, Data Scientists, PhDs, best-in-class customer support representatives, and more to deliver top results for our customers.

Our core values are our guiding principles in everything we do

- Customer Obsession

- Take Ownership

- Do The Right Thing

- Go Far Together

- Accelerate Innovation

The Role:

As a part of helping property owners reduce their property taxes, we regularly work with government entities across the country. Each entity has its own rules, government forms, and tax appeal filing deadlines which require us to have top-notch communication and execution.

In this role, you'll be the backbone of our Operations team. You'll be responsible for helping the broader team stay on track by keeping us organized, ensuring documents are promptly filed and recorded, and helping us establish new processes to improve efficiency.

An ideal candidate will be the most organized person you've ever met, with great attention to detail, a quick learner, and highly motivated to take on more. This opportunity provides entry and endless growth opportunities at a hyper-growth startup!

Responsibilities:

- Verify customer information and details of real estate properties

- Execute data entry from government websites (tax rates, property addresses, owner information, etc.)

- File appropriate documents with tax assessment offices on tight schedules and coordinate with government counterparts

- Learn to become proficient in both real estate and the property tax system

- Exhibit effective time management while proactively working with the Operations team to file on-time property tax appeals

- Develop and share best practices with team members to continually improve the quality, efficiency, and value of operations

Requirements:

- Highly organized with attention to detail

- Strong written and verbal communications skills

- Quick learner, self-motivated, and a team player

- Ability and desire to excel in a fast-paced environment

- Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets experience

- Experience in an administrative, coordination, or customer support role

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.summary: The U.S. mortgage market is a $14 trillion pillar of the economy — and much of it still runs on fax machines, overnight shipping, and manual workflows. Snapdocs is changing that.
jobs.description:
The U.S. mortgage market is a $14 trillion pillar of the economy — and much of it still runs on fax machines, overnight shipping, and manual workflows. Snapdocs is changing that. Our platform currently powers 20% of all real estate closings in the country, and we’re just getting started.
We design workflow software and AI-driven automation that connects lenders, settlement teams, notaries, and investors — eliminating friction, reducing risk, and delivering a faster, simpler closing for every borrower. Our customers range from the largest mortgage lenders to independent title companies. They trust us because we solve real operational pain with empathy, rigor, and reliability.
We’re backed by Sequoia, Y Combinator, and F-Prime, and we’re building for the long term.
Why this role exists
Snapdocs is the trusted infrastructure for high-stakes transactions. We started in mortgage, where trust is not assumed, the work is fragmented across many parties, and the cost of mistakes is real - and are bringing that same standard of trust to other markets.
Years of automating the hardest tasks gave us something more foundational than workflow software: an AI-native platform that makes complex work easy to complete, hard to get wrong, and built to withstand scrutiny over time.
Field marketing turns that promise into tangible presence and relationships in the market by owning the programs that put Snapdocs in front of the right audiences, in the right settings, for the right reasons. You’ll turn conferences, executive programs, customer gatherings, partner activations, and account-based programs into credible brand experiences, tight relationships, and measurable commercial impact.

The role
This is a hands-on field marketing role with broad ownership. You’ll help shape where and why Snapdocs shows up, choose the programs most relevant to our audiences and business priorities, manage the details that make those programs work, and connect every program to coordinated Sales and Marketing follow-up.
Events are the primary channel, but field marketing is broader than event execution. It also includes regional programs, executive presence, customer and prospect engagement, partner programs, and account-based plays across Snapdocs’ markets. You’ll help make our mission tangible by creating experiences that simplify complexity, build trust, and move the right relationships forward.

What you'll own
- Take ownership of a strong, existing events lineup for mortgage, primarily geared towards sales in-person meetings, and then building the playbook for expanding event presence on-stage, in new thought-leadership forums and through field motions.

- Strategize a new non-real-estate events plan, including identifying strategic event and field motions in priority adjacent industries, designed to establish credibility, develop relationships, and create pipeline in those markets.

- Unify existing and new vertical field marketing strategies into a tiered event strategy across industry, partner, customer, and executive programs.

- Decide the right level of presence for each program, from attendance and executive meetings to sponsorships, booths, speaking opportunities, roundtables, dinners, and roadshows.

- Run event programs end to end: goals, budget, registrations, vendors, booth and materials, attendee lists, on-site execution, and follow-up.

- Partner with Lender and Settlement Sales to connect event plans to target accounts, meetings, and next steps, ensuring event participation converts into a repeatable pipeline and revenue motion, strengthens Snapdocs’ credibility across the mortgage ecosystem and new verticals, and builds executive, partner, and customer relationships that support growth

- Work with Revenue Marketing on pre-event outreach, in-event signal capture, and post-event follow-up, including help with prospecting, messaging and social engagement.

- Use HubSpot as the system of record for event planning, lists, activity tracking, and handoffs, with Salesforce and Slack connected where needed.

- Track cost per attendee, meetings booked, meeting follow-up, qualified opportunities, pipeline impact, and 30-day post-event ROI. Use what you learn to make sharper investment calls.

What we're looking for
- 4+ years of field marketing, event marketing, or go-to-market marketing experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, financial services, or a similarly complex industry.

- A track record of owning events or field programs that contributed to qualified meetings, pipeline, customer relationships, or revenue.

- Excellent project management. You keep many workstreams moving, write clear next steps, and make it obvious who owns what and when.

- Strong judgment on event investment. You can assess attendee lists, audience fit, sponsorship value, sales goals, cost, and expected return before recommending a program.

- Experience working closely with sales, customers, partners, vendors, and executives. You make it easy for others to do their part and keep things from falling through the cracks.

- Comfort learning and operating marketing automation, CRM, lead capture, or event systems. Direct HubSpot experience is a plus.

- Experience working on a lean marketing team with broad ownership, from deciding where to invest to making sure the room is ready.

- Ability to travel to industry events, customer programs, and executive gatherings. Travel will be dependent on the specific event needs, but this role is not required to be at every event, instead using good judgment and clear evaluation of need to determine on-site presence levels.

AI proficiency at Snapdocs
AI proficiency is a core expectation at Snapdocs. We expect you to use AI as part of your day-to-day work, with real judgment about where it helps and where you need to check the output.

For this role, that might include researching events, organizing event data, drafting outreach or briefs, building repeatable planning workflows, and connecting systems for regular check-ins and next steps for supporting partners. You should be curious about new uses, able to explain what changed in your work, and willing to verify what AI produces before it reaches a customer or sales team.

Compensation and benefits
We believe in being upfront about pay. The base salary range for this role is as follows:
- $131,000 - $150,000

Where you land within the range depends on your experience, skills, and how you'll make an impact in the role. In addition to base salary and variable compensation, this position includes meaningful equity and a comprehensive benefits package.
Why Snapdocs
We’re here to transform one of the most critical and complex industries in the world. That requires a team that is curious, driven, thoughtful, and practical. We value:
- Product discipline and clear reasoning

- Deep ownership of outcomes (not just tasks)

- Straightforward, honest communication

- Empathy for the people who use our software

This is a place for people who want to solve hard, meaningful problems with real economic impact — not just ship features.

Join Us
We’re expanding our product suite and the network it connects. To do that, we need people who are excited by complexity, energized by scale, and motivated to make a tangible dent in how the mortgage ecosystem works. If you’re hungry to learn, build, and lead — you’ll do the best work of your career here.

jobs.title: Field Operations Manager
jobs.summary: Lessen is the tech-enabled, end-to-end property service provider that is transforming how commercial and residential real estate services are delivered and managed at scale.
jobs.description:
Lessen is the tech-enabled, end-to-end property service provider that is transforming how commercial and residential real estate services are delivered and managed at scale. Lessen’s technology platform provides data-driven insights that unlock key growth opportunities for the entire real estate ecosystem—including investors, owners, managers, and service providers. The company leverages a network of over 30,000 vetted, qualified vendors (Lessen Affiliates) serving clients with over 1 million properties and completing more than 3.5 million work orders annually across an expanding range of services. Lessen, LLC is a venture-backed, privately held company with offices in Scottsdale and Chicago. 

The Field Operations Manager plays an integral role in client support and account management through direct engagement with provision of services at the customers’ sites. This role works closely with multiple internal and external stakeholders to address daily client challenges, while identifying and executing opportunities to make meaningful improvements to client operations. 

-
Improve the delivery of services to the client by observing and reporting on performance and experience from an on-site-user perspective, both customer and vendor

-
Provide the Operations team with local insight regarding the unique needs of customers in the assigned market and the nuances of doing business with local vendors

-
Represent SMS in matters related to Fire/Life Safety, Environmental Health and Safety, and Disaster Recovery to mitigate the cost of unnecessarily expansive scopes of work

-
Provide administrative support for matters requiring in-person representation, such as dealing with municipal offices and being present for code inspections

-
Assure client leadership that SMS is effectively resolving all facilities issues through local engagement on high priority issues, prior to client escalation

-
Enhance the effectiveness of SMS technology solutions through increased adoption by directly demonstrating the platform’s value to both customer and vendor

-
Build and maintain professional relationships with clients to gain an understanding of their operational needs; assist in the development and implementation of solutions to meet those needs

-
Proactively manage delivery of services to sites without permanent client employees such as vacant sites and off-premise ATM locations

-
Maintain cognizance of work being done by third party vendors at client sites such as new build construction projects, branch decommissionings, or other projects falling outside the SMS scope of work; represent SMS in the acceptance of such projects into the Facilities portfolio

-
Perform non-maintenance tasks related to facilities management as approved by the Director of Operations

-
Demonstrate SMS’s commitment to consistent high-quality service through scheduled and unscheduled quality assurance visits

-
In coordination with the Affiliate Relationship Management team, develop business relationships with vendors to achieve seamless, high-quality service and advantageous pricing

-
Communicate findings and recommendations based on client data clearly; couple insights with actionable conclusions to drive business decisions

-
Facilitate the flow of information among customers and affiliates in the field and the SMS Operations team

-
Foster a positive team environment and may provide coaching or mentoring to team members

-
Ensures confidentiality and accuracy of internal and external data

-
Performs ad-hoc projects and other duties as assigned

-
This position is remote and requires up to 60% travel within the assigned geographic area of responsibility

-
Possesses specific knowledge of facilities management and general knowledge of building maintenance trades

-
Computer Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook required

-
5+ years of experience in facilities management, maintenance management, or building maintenance trades required

-
Bachelor’s Degree

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.summary: If you’re good at what you do, you can work anywhere. If you’re the best at what you do, come work for Doma Technology.
jobs.description:
If you’re good at what you do, you can work anywhere. If you’re the best at what you do, come work for Doma Technology.

About Us 

Doma Technology LLC offers solutions for lenders, real estate professionals, title agents, and homeowners that make closings vastly simpler and more efficient, reducing cost and increasing customer satisfaction.

Our Values

- Obsessively Entrepreneurial - We encourage calculated risk-taking, and we know that some of our best learning happens by making mistakes along the way.

- People First - We communicate with honesty and respect to our customers, colleagues, and partners.

- Better Together - We believe diversity, equity and inclusion creates value through the differences in our backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

- Act with Integrity - We hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards in all of our business practices.

Doma is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to own and evolve Looker, the business intelligence platform our Operations teams rely on for real-time, day-to-day reporting — SLAs, exception management, escalations, hands-on time reporting, turnaround times, vendor management, and more. You’ll be the primary point of contact for Looker across the company: owning the connectivity between Snowflake and our other source data and Looker end-to-end, building and maintaining the dashboards that keep Operations running, safeguarding data quality and provenance, and partnering with Finance, Data Science, and other business units on their reporting needs. We’re also looking for someone excited about what comes next — ideally with experience building or working hands-on with AI/agentic reporting tools — to help us build an agentic reporting layer on that same underlying data so business users can self-serve ad hoc questions that don't require long term dashboards.

You're fired up to:
• Use your raw data analysis intuition to revolutionize a 150-year-old industry
• Own, build, and maintain the Looker dashboards and data models that Operations, Finance, and Data Science depend on every day
• Own the connectivity between Snowflake and other source data and Looker — the pipelines, data models, and integrations that keep our reporting layer accurate and current end-to-end
• Be the primary point of contact for Looker company-wide — fielding requests, triaging issues, and setting standards for how dashboards get built
• Oversee data quality and data provenance across our reporting layer
• Play a key role in day-to-day operational decision-making — SLAs, exception management, escalations, hands-on time reporting, turnarounds, and vendor management — through rapid delivery of insights
• Design and help build an agentic reporting layer on top of our existing data — working hands-on with AI reporting agents so business users can self-serve ad hoc requests instead of filing a ticket
• Learn and leverage the ins and outs of a complex, valuable problem domain in title insurance and real estate

You definitely have:
• 3-5 years contributing to data analytics, business intelligence, or data science projects, ideally across a variety of professional contexts (e.g. start-ups and large companies, or consumer- and business-facing applications)
• Professional experience using Looker — LookML, dashboard design, and data modeling
• Ability to write complex SQL joins in your sleep
• Professional experience writing code with proficiency in Python, git, and similar tools
• Ability to communicate technical concepts to people throughout the company, including business partners in Operations, Product, and senior leadership
• Strong opinions, loosely held, about all things data

You might even have:
• Ideally, hands-on experience building, configuring, or working with AI/LLM-based reporting agents or similar agentic analytics tooling — prompt design, pipeline setup, and keeping an agent grounded in accurate underlying data
• Experience owning data pipelines or connectivity between a warehouse (e.g. Snowflake) and a BI tool like Looker
• Experience in the domains of risk, real estate, title, and/or insurance
• Experience owning data quality or governance for a BI platform at scale

jobs.summary: Who We Are Invitation Homes is a team of more than 1,700 associates who come from all walks of life. We call different communities “home," but our shared values bind us together.
jobs.description:
Who We Are
Invitation Homes is a team of more than 1,700 associates who come from all walks of life. We call different communities “home," but our shared values bind us together. Invitation Homes is a place where possibility lives.

The market teams include our Leasing, Property Management and Rehab, Turns & Maintenance professionals. Together, our dedicated associates work hard to build excellent resident experiences while maintaining high-quality homes and ensuring potential residents are presented with a rental property they can’t refuse.

Your Role on the Team
As a Superintendent at Invitation Homes you are responsible for full-cycle oversight of property rehab and turnover efforts. This includes but is not limited to the following tasks:
- Meeting with residents to complete Pre Move-Out Visits and documenting the home condition and resident responsibilities for a successful move-out.

- Meeting with incoming residents to complete Resident Orientations to welcome them, and educate them on the systems in their home as well as all important maintenance policies and procedures

- Conducting Move Out Inspections including a detailed inspection of the property and using our budgeting program to create a comprehensive scope of work and identify costs that should be charged back to the resident at move-out in accordance with company standards

- Overseeing all aspects of the rehab and turn process which includes communicating with contractors, submitting change orders, ensuring work is completed correctly and on schedule, and documenting the process with progress notes and “before” and “after” photos

- Communicating with the Leasing Team about completion delays that might affect a resident’s move-in date

- Observing and ensuring job site safety during project management visits

- Negotiating terms of repairs with vendors and General Contractors based on company standards

- May be required to conduct occupancy checks and attend eviction lockouts/setouts in coordination with local law enforcement

- Performing other duties as assigned

Your Experience Includes
- High school diploma or equivalent

- OSHA 10 is required (new hires will have up to 90 days to complete OSHA 10 certification if not already certified)

- Minimum two years of project management experience managing multiple projects, budgets, timelines, and quality of work

- General knowledge of residential construction including plumbing, electrical, mechanical, HVAC, drywall, and flooring as well as local building codes

- Negotiating with and managing contractors to complete work

- Professional verbal and written communication skills

- Comfortability with using a tablet and general business applications (e.g. Outlook, Salesforce, etc.)

- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills

- Current driver’s license and automobile insurance

- Must provide basic hand and power tools 

- Ability to be at work on a regular and consistent basis including on weekends and non-traditional holidays if needed

- Extensive travel within assigned portfolio required

- Physical requirements include:
- Frequent climbing, reaching, use of fingers, stooping, kneeling, crawling, pushing, pulling, lifting, talking, and hearing

- Ability to lift and/or move an excess of 50 pounds or more and operate standard maintenance equipment as assigned

Why Us
We stand for flexibility, opportunity, and a home that people can make their own. It’s as true for our associates as it is for our residents. Just like we help our residents live freer, we liberate our associates’ careers, too. Our associates know that goals matter, potential is unlocked, and careers thrive. Invitation Homes isn’t just a workplace but a possibility place. We offer each new associate:
- Competitive pay and an annual bonus program for all associates

- Generous paid time off plans including vacation accrual, sick time, volunteer time, and standard and floating holidays

- 401k with matching company contributions

- Awesome work environment with casual dress

- Team events and gatherings

- Employee resource groups: Together with Women, Asian Alliance, Black Collective, Juntos, Gen Next, Valor, and Open Invitation.

Build a foundation here and apply today!

Salary Range
The salary range for this position is: $57,862.50 - $100,295.00, plus individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications, location, and applicable employment laws.

Compensation and Benefits
To attract and retain top talent, we're pleased to offer competitive compensation and benefits, including:
- Annual bonus program

- Health, dental, vision, and life insurance

- Long-term and short-term disability insurance

- Generous paid time off plans include vacation accrual, sick time, standard holidays and floating holidays

- 401(k) with company matching contributions

- Awesome work environment with casual dress

- Team events and gatherings (Pre- and Post-Covid)

Invitation Homes is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and innovative environment with the best associates. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at humanresources@invitationhomes.com.

- Providing excellent customer service and promoting a quality living experience for all residents

- Properly using and caring for company-supplied tools, materials, and vehicles

- Ability to lift and/or move an excess of 50 pounds or more and operate standard maintenance equipment as assigned

jobs.summary: Position Overview The Analyst, CAM drives day-to-day asset management across the Build-to-Rent (BTR) community portfolio.
jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Analyst, CAM drives day-to-day asset management across the Build-to-Rent (BTR) community portfolio. This role bridges operational execution and data-driven strategy — owning performance reporting, managing cross-functional partnerships, and implementing process improvements that lift occupancy, NOI, and resident satisfaction. The associate takes on direct accountability for strategy identification and implementation, KPI tracking, forecasting, and portfolio-level coordination while building toward future leadership responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

Asset Performance & Reporting
- Own community-level performance reporting: build and maintain dashboards in Power BI/Tableau/Claude tracking occupancy, leasing velocity, maintenance costs, and resident satisfaction
- Produce weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reports for market and corporate leadership, translating data into clear narratives and actionable recommendations
- Support portfolio-level reviews to identify underperforming assets; track corrective action plans
- Analyze data and identify trends and key findings in both qualitative and quantitative data sets from various systems
- Conduct variance analysis on budgets, forecasts, and capital expenditures; surface anomalies and proposed resolutions
- Maintain and continuously improve data integrity across Yardi, Salesforce, and all reporting portals
- Support community-specific asset management strategies to maximize occupancy, NOI, and resident retention
- Serve as the central liaison between corporate Asset Management and on-site teams, marketing, maintenance, leasing, and technology
- Conduct regular market and community audits to ensure alignment with asset performance goals and brand standards
- Identify operational inefficiencies and lead process improvement initiatives across the portfolio
- Assist in oversight of special projects related to community enhancements, capital improvements, and operational scaling
- Champion resident engagement programs and community events to maintain high satisfaction scores and low turnover
- Analyze resident satisfaction data and maintenance trends; recommend proactive measures to improve retention
- Evaluate vendor performance using data-driven scorecards; escalate issues as needed
- Assist in annual budgeting, forecasting, and capital planning exercises
- Monitor actuals vs. budget using advanced Excel financial models; flag risks and opportunities early
- Identify opportunities to design new and/or refine existing analyses and processes to improve the asset management team’s productivity, accuracy, and efficiency over time

Qualifications

Education and/or Experience
- Bachelor’s degree and strong academic record in Finance, Economics, Quantitative Analytics, or related fields required
- 2+ years analytical support roles, in property management, asset management, or multifamily/BTR operations
- Demonstrated familiarity with Single-Family Rental (SFR) or Build-to-Rent communities and new home building processes
- Experience creating investment and portfolio presentations for Senior leadership a plus
- Strong experience working with large data sets and performing exploratory data analysis required

Technical Skills
- Advanced proficiency in Power BI or Tableau — ability to build and maintain executive-level dashboards
- Experience with Python, R, Capital IQ, John Burns, Salesforce, and Yardi a plus
- Expert-level Excel: pivot tables, financial modeling, variance analysis, and data visualization
- Hands-on experience with Yardi and/or RealPage, including reporting and operational modules

Your Role on the Team
As a Superintendent at Invitation Homes you are responsible for full-cycle oversight of property rehab and turnover efforts. This includes but is not limited to the following tasks:
- Meeting with residents to complete Pre Move-Out Visits and documenting the home condition and resident responsibilities for a successful move-out.

- Meeting with incoming residents to complete Resident Orientations to welcome them, and educate them on the systems in their home as well as all important maintenance policies and procedures

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager, AI
jobs.summary: Funnel Leasing Inc., is hiring for a Strategy & Operations Manager, AI. The Strategy & Operations Manager, AI is responsible for driving the strategic direction and go-to-market st…
jobs.description:
Funnel Leasing Inc., is hiring for a Strategy & Operations Manager, AI. The Strategy & Operations Manager, AI is responsible for driving the strategic direction and go-to-market strategy for Funnel’s cutting-edge AI products, becoming the accountable party for the segment’s P&L. Collaborating closely with customers of all sizes, you'll gain valuable insights into their AI strategies, ensuring seamless alignment of Funnel’s products with their unique needs and Funnel’s overarching goals. Your role will involve conducting research to pinpoint trends, customer preferences, and competitive dynamics that will inform Funnel’s corporate strategy and product roadmap. With ownership of Funnel’s pricing and packaging strategies, you'll strike the balance between product value, market demand, and profit margin. You will have the responsibility of leading and elevating the future of Funnel’s AI-driven solutions while improving the country’s rental experience. The Salary range for this role is $125,000 to $145,000/year.
Why Funnel?
We are a 'work from anywhere' in the U.S. SaaS company that centers our services on the renter experience. We develop amazing software that has revolutionized the #proptech industry. And did we mention we have an amazing team that is on #FunnelFire!? Oh, did we forget to tell you we have unlimited PTO, benefits that begin on your first day of employment, P.I.N.K. core values that ROCK, and our team puts the FUN in Funnel!
Who is Funnel Leasing?
Have you ever rented an apartment and wished the process could be better? At Funnel we do too. We know we need to make the process of renting an apartment as easy as purchasing socks on Amazon. We’ve created cloud-based marketing and leasing software that delivers the ultimate rental experience for everyone involved in the process. We’re in the process of transforming the real estate industry through cutting-edge technology built, sold, and supported by the most passionate people you’ll meet.

The Strategy & Operations Manager, AI essential roles and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

Roles and responsibilities
- Lead the strategy and GTM approach for Funnel’s AI products (VLA, VVLA, MA, & new AI offerings/integrations).
- Track and analyze financial data to make informed decisions regarding resource allocation, investment opportunities, and cost optimization, being accountable for the financial success of Funnel’s AI segment P&L (Will work with Finance to create a P&L).
- Take ownership of pricing and packaging strategies in collaboration with sales/marketing, optimizing them to reflect product value and market demands, with the goal of maximizing margins where possible.
- Conduct market research to identify trends, customer preferences, and competitive dynamics which you will use to inform Funnel’s product and strategy decisions.
- Collaborate with customers of all sizes (e.g., Enterprise, Mid-Market) to gain insights into their AI strategies; ensuring that our products are aligned with their needs / objectives.
- Drive the evaluation between off-the-shelf and proprietary AI solutions, considering the dynamic landscape of the industry.
- Be the connective tissue between product/engineering, revenue, and CX regarding Funnel’s AI related products and strategy.
- Strategically engage in select sales engagements to accelerate segment attachment, overall ARR growth, and increase the percentage of Funnel ARR from the segment.
- Manage various product marketing initiatives around Funnel’s suite of AI products, ensuring Funnel is successfully selling the value of the products (throughout marketing/sales lifecycle) and bringing new AI products to market.
- Engage with executive leadership, department heads, and external stakeholders to harmonize product strategies with overarching organizational goals.
- Travel:
Education, Work Experience, and Certifications
- 3+ years of experience in strategy consulting, investment banking/private equity, AND/OR a top-tier tech company in strategy, business operations, or growth.
- Proven track record of running cross-functional initiatives, achieving goals, and succeeding in a team environment
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and interpersonal skills.
- Passion to do whatever it takes to solve complex problems and build scalable processes.
- Comfort working in a high growth, constantly changing environment

You'll really impress us if you have:
- A JD or MBA
- Experience in the real estate industry
- Experience at a SaaS company.
- Knowledge of and interest in artificial intelligence.
- An obsession with challenging the status quo.

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Funnel, we are committed to building a proptech company that is as diverse as the multifamily industry we serve, and that means to not only live our inclusivity, but also to support and encourage it among all of society. If you are excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.
Equal Employment Opportunity
Funnel provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to race, creed, color, citizenship, religion, national origin, age, sex, familial or marital status, pregnancy, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability, or any other legally-protected status in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws, regulations, and ordinances.
Americans with Disabilities Act
Employees must be able to perform all essential job functions, with or without reasonable accommodation.
Job Responsibilities
The above statements reflect the general duties, responsibilities and competencies considered necessary to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job and should not be considered as a detailed description of all the work requirements of the position. Funnel may change the specific job duties with or without prior notice based on the needs of the organization.

Benefits
Employees may be eligible for various benefits. Generally, we provide employee access to:

 - Health insurance
 - Dental and Vision insurance
 - Company paid Life/AD&D
 - Long-term Disability insurance
 - Short-term Disability insurance
 - Term Life insurance
 - Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
 - Health Savings Account (HSA)

 - EAP

In addition to these benefits, we also offer

Since 2003, Entrata has evolved from a visionary, student-led startup into a global leader in AI-driven property management technology. - Contributes to the creation of product value statements, product performance metrics, and feedback loops to monitor customer satisfaction.

- Participates in executing market validation activities for released epics, including customer conversations, interviews, and research.

- Participates in evaluating the performance of AI-driven processes or outputs by identifying drift, hallucinations, inefficiencies, or bias and recommending prompt or workflow adjustments.

- 2+ years of experience in product management or related roles within the software industry.

- Conducts research, analysis, and customer validation activities to inform product decisions.

- Develops and maintains product documentation, including epics, user stories, and requirements.

- Collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment on product priorities and delivery.

- Contributes to product backlog refinement and prioritization activities.

- Ability to prioritize tasks effectively by meeting deadlines and managing workload efficiently.

- Maintain professional interaction with internal and external stakeholders

- Ability to work in a fast-paced and high-stress environment

- Intermediate understanding of product management principles, customer needs, and company processes.

- Ability to apply guidelines, best practices, and analysis to moderately complex product tasks.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills for conveying product requirements and findings to varied audiences.

- Ability to adapt communication style to stakeholders and contribute to collaborative problem-solving.

- Demonstrated ability to organize work, follow established procedures, and exercise discretion in resolving non-standard issues.

- Advanced prompting expertise, including the ability to design multi-step prompts with embedded logic, recursion, and context chaining to produce highly reliable outputs.

- Context engineering proficiency for managing structured and unstructured inputs to optimize LLM reasoning and relevance.

- Working knowledge of transformer-based LLM architectures, attention mechanisms, tokenization, context windows, RAG approaches, and common model failure modes.

- Proficiency in workflow automation using AI tools, LLMs, or agentic systems to orchestrate complex, multi-step processes with human-in-the-loop controls where appropriate.

- Familiarity with tool integration and agentic reasoning, including the ability to chain LLMs with APIs, vector databases, or code execution environments.

- Ability to critically evaluate AI outputs for drift, hallucination, bias, or inefficiencies and refine prompts or processes accordingly.

- Experience leveraging AI tooling for analytics, pattern detection, and predictive modeling to support product decisions.

- Demonstrated track record of using AI to significantly improve efficiency, throughput, or quality across business or technical workflows.

- Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or a relevant advanced degree without experience; or equivalent work experience.

- Experience contributing to product teams or supporting product development activities.

- Advanced prompting expertise: Capable of designing sophisticated, multi-step prompts with embedded logic, recursion, and context chaining to produce highly specific and reliable outputs across diverse domains.

- Context engineering mastery: Skilled in managing structured and unstructured inputs across system and user prompts to optimize LLM reasoning, retention, and relevance.

- Working knowledge of LLM architectures: Understanding of transformer-based architectures, including attention mechanisms, tokenization and context window limitations, fine-tuning strategies, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and the typical failure modes of frontier models.

- Workflow Automation proficiency: Proven experience designing and implementing AI-augmented workflows that reduce manual effort and enhance throughput and precision, especially using LLMs and AI agents in the orchestration of complex, multistep processes, including human-in-the-loop safeguards where appropriate

- Tool integration & agentic reasoning: Familiarity with chaining LLMs with tools, APIs, vector databases, or code execution environments to complete dynamic, multi-context tasks.

- Critical evaluation of AI performance: Ability to detect model drift, hallucinations, bias, or inefficiencies—and to refine prompt or architecture design accordingly.

- AI-driven data analysis: Proficiency with leveraging data and AI tooling for advanced analytics, pattern recognition, and predictive modeling.

- AI-accelerated productivity: Demonstrated track record of using AI tools to 10x impact—whether in ideation, execution, analysis, or delivery—across a range of business or technical domains.

- AI Integration: Utilize company-approved GenAI tools to accelerate high-value deliverables.

- Strategic Oversight: Exercise critical judgment as the "Human-in-the-Loop," by auditing AI outputs for factual accuracy, brand alignment, and the removal of hallucinations.

- Data Governance: Ensures no proprietary or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data is exposed to unauthorized models.

- Prompt Competency: Demonstrates the ability to craft clear, context-rich prompts to achieve consistent, high-quality results across various business domains.
